title: Kartik Month Deep Daan
description: The Soul of Braj Federation celebrates the auspicious Kartik Month with Deep Daan (offering of lamps), which is considered one of the most significant devotional acts during this period.

title: Health Awareness Camp
description: A free health camp providing essential check-ups, consultations, and awareness sessions on preventive healthcare. Medical professionals will offer general health screenings, blood pressure checks, and dietary guidance. Take charge of your well-being and spread the message of a healthier society!

title: Sanitary Pad Distribution
description: Initiative ASHA Soul of Braj Federation organize free monthly sanitary pad distribution to Hundreds of adolescent girls and underserved community women in Shri Vrindavan Dham under their initiative.
